name: Luke Skywalker
note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero luke-skywalker), mirrored from the-unmatched.club deck 12306 "Luke Skywalker" by Rogue RaiderOne (https://www.the-unmatched.club/c/heroes/luke-skywalker.12306), version 2026.07.22 "Art Overhaul". A community deck, balanced by its author — TUC has no unmatched.cards page, so the deck id is ours and this snapshot is the only source. Card faces are the author's OWN finished renders (the replacementImage set he uploaded to TUC, identical to the pixels in his TTS export), self-hosted in public/evergreen-decks/art/luke-skywalker and drawn full-bleed via cardImage — never through the generated card template, which cannot reproduce his banners and layout. Card values/boosts/types mirror the live engine catalog (protocol 25, probed 2026-07-29); URLs are repo-relative (malfurion precedent) so the art resolves on localhost and preview builds too. Also mirrored here but not referenced by any UI surface yet: art/luke-skywalker/hero-card.webp, the author's own hero-card render (his TUC `customImage`). The character-select splash paints its art as a cover background BEHIND the panel's own name/credit overlay, where a text-heavy card render is unreadable, so the splash + roster tile + seat plate all use cardback.webp like every sibling deck. Kept in-repo so the render is never hotlinked from imgur if a surface for it lands.
